description: Techniques to validate and improve model performance

slides.title: Cross-Validation
slides.content:
# Cross-Validation (K-Fold) 🔄

Checking accuracy on just one test set might be lucky (or unlucky).

## How K-Fold Works
1. Split data into `K` parts (folds) (e.g., 5).
2. Train on 4 parts, test on 1 part.
3. Repeat 5 times, rotating the test part.
4. Average the 5 scores.

Gives a much more robust estimate of model performance!

slides.title: Hyperparameter Tuning
slides.content:
# Tuning the Knobs 🎛️

Parameters methods learn (weights), Hyperparameters YOU allow (learning rate, tree depth).

## Grid Search
Try EVERY combination of settings.
- Rate: [0.1, 0.01], Depth: [3, 5, 10]
- **Pros**: Finds best.
- **Cons**: Extremely slow.

## Random Search
Try random combinations for a set time.
- **Pros**: Faster and often finds near-optimal results.

slides.title: Overfitting vs Underfitting
slides.content:
# The Bias-Variance Tradeoff ⚖️

## Overfitting (High Variance)
- Model learns the "noise" in training data.
- **Signs**: 99% Training Accuracy, 70% Test Accuracy.
- **Fix**: More data, simplify model, regularization, dropout.

## Underfitting (High Bias)
- Model is too simple to learn the pattern.
- **Signs**: 60% Training, 59% Test (Both bad).
- **Fix**: More complex model, more features.

slides.quizQuestion: If your model has high training accuracy but low test accuracy, what is it suffering from?
